content: Yihuda Kawa Abiya
Nabaaxa na7ay Iyorbaami kawotida tammanne hospuntho laythan Abiyi Yihudan kawotis.
Abiyi Yerusalaamen heedzu laythi kawotis. Iya aayiya Abeseloome na7a; I sunthay Ma7iko.
Iyape kase, iya aaway oothida nagara ubbaa oothis. Iya wozanay iya aawa aaway Dawita wozanay polo gididaysada Godaa, ba Xoossaa sinthan polo gidenna.
Gidoshin, iyape guye Yerusalaamen kawotana melanne Yerusalaame sarotethaa naagana mela Goday iya Xoossay, Dawita gisho Abiyas issi adde na7aa immis.
Goday hessa oothiday, Dawiti Hite addiya Ooriyoona bolla nagara oothidaysafe attishin, ba de7o laytha ubban Godaa kiitaape issibaaka balibeenna.
Abiyi de7ida laytha ubban Robi7aaminne Iyorbaami oletishe de7idosona.
Abiyi hanida harabaynne I oothidaba ubbay Yihuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis. Abiyinne Iyorbaami oletishe de7idosona.
Abiyi hayqidi ba mayzatan gahetis; I Dawita Kataman moogetis; iya bessan iya na7ay Asi kawotis.
Yihuda Kawa Asa
Isra7eele kawoy Iyorbaami kawotida laatamantho laythan Asi Yihudan kawotis.
Asi Yerusalaamen oytamanne issi laythi kawotis. Iya wogga aaye sunthay Ma7iko; iya Abeseloome na7a.
Asi ba mayzay Dawiti oothidaysada, Godaa sinthan suureba oothis.
Goyinno woga oothidi addey addera laymatesata Asi biittafe dhaysis. Iyape kase de7iya kawoti medhida eeqa misileta ubbaa mentherethis.
Iya wogga aayiya Ma7ika Asheera geetetiya xoossees tuna eeqa misile medhida gisho, kawo aayo geetetiya boncho bessaafe iyo diggis. Asi he eeqa misiliya qanxerethidi Qediroona Zangaaran xuuggis.
Asi dhoqa goyinno bessata ubbaa dhaysona aggikoka, I ba de7ida laytha ubban Xoossas ammanetiya asi gididi de7is.
Inne iya aaway Xoossas dummayidi wothida bira, worqanne hara miisheta ehidi, Xoossa keethan wothis.
Yihuda kawoy Asinne Isra7eele kawoy Ba7oosi, banta laytha ubban olan de7idosona.
Isra7eele kawoy Ba7oosi Yihuda bolla dendidi, Yihuda kawa Asa biittafe oonika gelonna melanne keyonna mela teqanaw Rama yuushuwa gimbis.

Hessa gaason kawoy Asi Xoossa keethaninne kawo gadhon de7iya worqanne bira ubbaa kessidi ba moorinnata kushen wothis. Heziyoona na7aa na7aa, Xabirmoona na7aas, Damasqon de7iya Araame kawa Ben-Hadaada imota oothidi yeddishe haysada yaagis;

“Kase ta aawaranne ne aawara caaqidaysada, ane taaranne neera caaqoos. Heko, taani ha biraanne worqaa taani new imota oothada yeddas. Isra7eele kawoy Ba7oosi ba olanchota ta biittafe kessana mela neeni kase iyara caaqida caaquwa mentha” yaagis.

Ben-Hadaadi kawoy Asi gidaysa ekidi, ba toora moconata Isra7eele katamata olanaw yeddis. Enti Iyoona, Daanenne Abeel-Beet-Ma7ika katamata, Galila Abbaa matan de7iya biittanne Niftaaleme biittara gathidi oykidosona.
Kawoy Ba7oosi hessa si7idi, Rama gimbeysa aggidi Tirsa bis.
Hessafe guye kawoy Asi Yihudan de7iya asa ubbaa kiittin, issoyka attonna dendidi, Ba7oosi yan go7etiya shuchaanne mithaa Ramape gaazidosona. Kawoy Asi Mixiphaninne Biniyaamen de7iya Gib7a gimbis.
Asi hanida harabay, iya minotethay ubbay, I oothidaba ubbaynne I keexida katamati Yihuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis. Shin I cimida wode ba tohuwa saketis.
Asi hayqidi, ba mayzatan gahetidi ba mayza Dawita Kataman moogetis. Iya na7ay Iyosaafexi iya bessan kawotis.
Isra7eele Kawa Nadaaba
Yihuda kawoy Asi kawotida nam7antho laythan Iyorbaama na7ay Naadabi Isra7eelen kawotis; I Isra7eele biittan nam7u laythi kawotis.
Naadabi kase ba aawa ogiyaninne Isra7eele asaa oosisida iya nagara ogiyan hemetidi Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.
Yisakoora koche gidida Akiya na7ay Ba7oosi Nadaaba bolla maqetis. He wode Naadabeynne iya olanchoti Filisxeemen de7iya Gibatoona katamaa yuushon de7oosona.
Yihuda kawoy Asi kawotida heedzantho laythan Ba7oosi Nadaaba wodhidi iya bessan I baw kawotis.
Ba7oosi kawoto doomida mela Iyorbaama soo asa ubbaa wodhidi wursis. Goday Seelope yida ba aylliya, nabiya Akiya baggara odidaysada Iyorbaama keetha asa ubbay hayqi wuris.
Hessi haniday, Iyorbaami ba huuphen oothida nagaraninne Isra7eele asaa I oosisida nagaran Godaa Isra7eele Xoossaa hanqethida gishosa.
Naadabi hanida harabaynne I oothidaba ubbay Isra7eele Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Yihuda kawoy Asinne Isra7eele kawoy Ba7oosi banta kawotetha laytha ubban oletida mela de7idosona.
Isra7eele Kawa Ba7oosa
Yihuda kawoy Asi kawotida heedzantho laythan Akiya na7ay Ba7oosi Isra7eele bolla kawotis; I Tirsa kataman uttidi laatamanne oyddu laythi kawotis.
Iyorbaami Isra7eele asaa nagara oosisidaysada ika he ogiyan hemetidi Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.
